title: Always on
blurb: One rhythmic triplet, each proof landing on a downbeat with a filtered stab and a brace snap. 'Then it runs on Replay's browsers': the real 'Tue at 3:00 AM · America/New_York' chip lifts under a large thin 3:00 AM like a name tag, a 'hosted by Replay' pill lands on 'browsers', and six ticks mark the six Tuesdays it really fired. Three environment words lift off the real Add environment row as pills and light red-pink as they are said. The Reminders · CI runs table, braces on the first blue PR #3 badge, an 'a test run for every PR' pill, and a ▶ recording chip popping out of every visible run row as each run is recorded, then reviewed, for what's slow as well as what breaks.

shots.setting: studio paper (#e9e8ea), drifting hairlines · 2026 · even studio light; a large thin '3:00 AM' with the real schedule chip as its name tag

lines.text: Then it runs on Replay's browsers. On a schedule, while you sleep.
lines.direction: picks up straight off 'runs them' with forward momentum, the second 'runs' an answer to 'where?': 'on Replay's browsers' plain and sure, the quiet 'you don't have to host anything' of the film; then the first tap of the triplet on 'On a schedule', and softer and warmer, almost a smile, on 'while you sleep' NARRATION (2026-10-14): take ran 216 wpm; breaths at the full stop and the comma.

shots.visual: ALL DRAWN, NO PRODUCT FOOTAGE (director's note 2026-10-14). Studio paper, two hairlines drifting. A large thin '3:00 AM' (Promo Sans light ≈ 128 px) blurs in at the top. On 'Then' a row of five small ABSTRACT browsers (sets/abstract browserWindow: title bar, skeleton page, red-pink recording dot) rises under it; on 'runs' each starts a run (skeleton lighting, progress hairline). On 'browsers' a 'hosted by Replay' pill (server icon) lands under the row, joined to it by a hairline bracket. On 'schedule' the real schedule 'Tue · America/New_York' (the account's Production environment) blurs in under the time with the red-pink underline, and six weekly ticks draw (Sep 1 → Oct 6, 'every Tuesday'). On 'sleep' a crescent moon rises beside the time, the time dims, the paper cools a touch from the top, and the runs finish one by one with green ✓s.

lines.text: Each run is recorded, then reviewed. For what breaks, and what's slow.
lines.direction: even and certain, two clean taps on 'recorded' and 'reviewed' (the first time the film says it aloud: every run is a recording); then 'For what breaks,' plain, and a small beat before a quiet, knowing 'and what's slow.' that hands off to the next register

shots.visual: Third of the triplet. A floating RrwebScreen (no chrome, NO cursor, soft shadow, tilt {x: 5, y: -12} settling flat by 0.6 s), ~1000 stage px wide, left of centre: take 'runs' from tape 2900 to mark list (3668) at real speed, then held (no scroll: it moves only 27.5 px). Crop ≈ {x: 500, y: 112, w: 940, h: 458} (verified on the rr-sheet frame at 3668): the 'Test Runs' heading and eight full rows of the 'Reminders · CI' table, columns Created / Description / Environment / Status / Bugs (PR #3, PR #1 and Project default runs, status pills Completed / Cancelled); NO chat column (x < 500), no tab strip (y 70-108), no localhost header. On 'pull' (downbeat, filtered stab) the zoom eases 1.0 → 1.6 toward recording (1015, 300) and kit bracket braces with corner dots snap around the first blue 'PR #3' badge (recording ≈ x 1015, y 224); the red-pink underline runs under it. On 'request' a kit pill slides in from the right beside the table, clear of it: 'a test run for every PR' (what the footage shows: PR-linked test runs from CI; no check or PR comment is depicted). Between 'request' and 'recorded' the zoom eases back 1.6 → 1.0 over 0.4 s (braces and underline fade with it), so all eight rows are in frame again. On 'recorded' a small rounded '▶ recording' chip pops out of each of the eight visible run rows in a quick cascade (≈ 0.1 s apart, top to bottom), each chip flying right and stacking neatly beside the pill: a chip per row, each standing for that run's recordings (a run records every journey it runs, so a many-journey run holds many recordings). On 'reviewed' a small green ✓ ticks onto the top chip of the stack. On 'For' a fresh, anonymous ninth chip (from no row) slides onto the bottom end of the stack, still neutral, with a tiny grey 'illustration' tag beside it (the same tag ch05 uses); on 'slow' it tints Replay red-pink: an illustration of a recording reviewed for slowness, not footage, and not a finding about any of these runs; the hint ch05 pays off. At the end of L0404 the stack settles. In the last 0.6 s a tape-stop: the frame's motion slows, the screen desaturates slightly and the stack of chips stays crisp (it is carried into ch05-s01's frame ribbon).
